texts.preamble: Mughlian Restaurant And Anr vs Union Territory Of J&K And Ors on 4 July, 2022 Author: Sanjay Dhar Bench: Sanjay Dhar S. No.82 Supplementary High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh At Srinagar Wp(C) No.1431/202 Cm No.3446/2022 Mughlian Restaurant and Anr. ..... Petitione Through: Mr. Salih Pirzada, Advocate V/s Union Territory of J&K and Ors. ..... Responde Through: None Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge Order
texts.facts: The petitioners have filed the instant petition challenging e-tender Notice No.12 of 2022 dated 18.06.2022, issued by respondent No.4, on the ground that the said tender notice has been issued in violation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereafter for short 'FSSAI Act') and the rules and regulations made thereunder. 2. The only ground projected by the petitioners in this petition is that through the medium of the impugned e-tender notice, the respondents are seeking to invite the bids for Group Outsourcing of Canteen Services at the Associated Hospitals of Government Medical College Srinagar in violation of FSSAI norms, though it is clearly indicated in the impugned tender notice that the tenders are to be submitted only by the registered Agencies/Firms under FSSAI norms for Group Outsourcing of Canteen Services at the Associated Hospitals of Government Medical College Srinagar.
texts.arguments: It has been further contended that in clause 21 of the conditions of impugned e-tender notice it is indicated that the diet facility will be subject to provisions of FSSAI Act and inspection of local Health Mughlian Restaurant And Anr vs Union Territory Of J&K And Ors on 4 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102439626/ 1 Authorities/Administration. 3. During the course of the arguments learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners would be satisfied if a direction is issued to the respondents to adhere to the provisions of FSSAI Act as well as the rules and regulations framed thereunder while finalizing the process of e-tendering initiated in terms of the impugned tender notice.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It has been further contended that in clause 21 of the conditions of impugned e-tender notice it is indicated that the diet facility will be subject to provisions of FSSAI Act and inspection of local Health Mughlian Restaurant And Anr vs Union Territory Of J&K And Ors on 4 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102439626/ 1 Authorities/Administration. 3. During the course of the arguments learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners would be satisfied if a direction is issued to the respondents to adhere to the provisions of FSSAI Act as well as the rules and regulations framed thereunder while finalizing the process of e-tendering initiated in terms of the impugned tender notice.
